CustomField.description: Optional tags for this template. They are NOT consumed by the package's conversion engine - no packaged flow or Apex reads them. They are stamped onto each new submission's Internal_Data_Conversion_Tag_s__c by the sample Global Form Submission Utility flows (force-app-demo, unpackaged) or by your own automation, so you can branch your own record-triggered Flows on which template produced a submission. A page section can override these per section via Form_Template_Page_Section__c.Data_Conversion_Tag_s__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional tags stamped onto each submission from this template - by the sample submission-utility flow or your own automation. Reference them in your own record-triggered Flow entry conditions to route or process submissions by template; the package's built-in conversion does not read them.
CustomField.label: Data Conversion Tag(s)
